item.title: Pollution Woes: Delhi allows only BS-6 vehicles from today; PUC mandatory
item.description: Delhi continues to battle severe air pollution as toxic smog engulfs the city. Authorities have tightened restrictions, allowing only BS-6 vehicles and enforcing strict PUC norms. Long queues and technical glitches at petrol pumps added to public distress.

item.title: Snowfall in hills, fog and cold wave grip plains; IMD issues alert
item.description: Winter has intensified across India with snowfall in the hills and dense fog and cold wave conditions in the plains. The IMD has issued alerts in several northern states due to an active western disturbance.

item.title: Gold prices rise further, Silver hits record high; Check rates here
item.description: Gold and silver prices surged further on December 18 amid strong domestic and global demand. In Delhi, 24-carat gold touched ₹134,670 per 10 grams, while silver climbed to ₹208,100 per kg.

item.title: Unsold at IPL auction, now scores explosive hundred with 17 boundaries in Test
item.description: Unsold at the IPL 2026 auction, New Zealand batter Devon Conway responded in style with a stunning Test century against West Indies. Conway smashed 100 off 149 balls, hitting 17 boundaries, proving his red-ball form remains strong.

item.title: Parliament Winter Session: Air pollution to be discussed in both houses today
item.description: The opposition has been demanding a dedicated discussion on air pollution since the start of the winter session of Parliament. Several MPs have questioned the government’s preparedness and long-term strategy to tackle the worsening air quality.

item.title: India loses legendary sculptor Ram Sutar; Designer of world’s tallest statue
item.description: Renowned sculptor Ram Vanji Sutar, designer of the Statue of Unity, passed away at 100 in Noida. Known for creating iconic sculptures of Mahatma Gandhi, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, and Chhatrapati Shivaji, Sutar received India’s Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan awards for his contributions.

item.title: Stock Market Update: Sensex slides 126 points as Stocks open in red; Nifty also falls
item.description: Indian stock markets opened lower on Thursday. The BSE Sensex fell 126 points to 84,433.62 in early trade, while the Nifty slipped 33.55 points to 25,785. Bank and midcap indices also traded in the red.

item.title: UP Under Severe Cold Wave: Dense fog alert in 20 districts, School timings revised
item.description: Most parts of the state experienced biting cold westerly winds along with dense fog, and a significant drop in daytime temperatures was recorded. In many districts, the daytime temperature plummeted well below normal, increasing the chill and biting cold. People had to resort to bonfires even during the day.

item.title: AAI issues dense fog advisory across north India; Airlines warn of flight disruptions
item.description: At the same time, various Airlines, including Air India and IndiGo, have also issued a travel advisory about possible disruptions at select destinations and therefore check the status of their flights.

item.title: Trump calls tariffs his “Favorite” word; Claims ending 8 wars in 10 months
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has once again grabbed headlines with his bold claims. Speaking about his policies, he asserted that his tariff strategy resolved eight international conflicts in just ten months.
